means: Head and shoulders filling the frame.
does: Hands the entire picture to the face. Every expression tag you set - brow, mouth, gaze, tears, eye render - only gets drawn at enough pixels to read once you are this close. It also deletes the location: the background collapses to an out-of-focus wash, so a close-up carries no information about where you are and cannot do an establishing job. In the shot_size sweep close is a head that fills the frame with the stadium reduced to a blur behind it.
reach_for_it: the emotional beat - a face receiving what was just said. This is where an episode earns its feeling.
used_in: the react and insert clauses of shot.purpose; the most-used framing tag in the whole library - films/chrono.json, films/carriage-seven.json, films/last-good-year.json and films/puddle.json each carry four or more
example_base: 1boy, solo, male focus, short dark hair, plain jacket, standing, city street, daytime
read_it_as: Compare the SHADING, colour and line - not the pose or framing. Adding any clause re-rolls the model's conditioning, so composition moves between the two panels even at a fixed seed. An img2img pass from one fixed base image would isolate the tag properly; that is not built yet.
